tier_reason: Downgraded B to C on the enricher's reading of the public harness and issues: the verify_new call is commented out in both mains so nothing checks results, every matrix value and x are set to 1.0, the FP16 rows accumulate in f16 while the cuSPARSE baseline computes FP32 (not like for like), and open issues #1 and #3 report wrong results with #4 asking whether the speedups are fake (an A100 user finds DASP slower than cuSPARSE on many matrices). The SC '23 paper remains unopened, and the independent CB-SpMV paper (ICS '25) measures 1.21x over DASP on A100 and 2.76x on RTX 4090 in FP64.

corrections.caveats: Harness has no result check (verify_new commented out in both mains); all matrix values and x are 1.0; y is returned in permuted row order; FP16 rows accumulate in f16 against an FP32 cuSPARSE baseline. Open issues #1 (wrong result with 1 iteration), #3 (wrong result on mip1), #4 ('Speedup are mostly fake data?', A100 user slower than cuSPARSE on many matrices including bibd_20_10). Independent: CB-SpMV (ICS '25, FP64, 2,843 matrices) is 1.21x faster than DASP on A100 and 2.76x on RTX 4090; arXiv 2502.16851 (snippet) finds cuSPARSE beats DASP on average for matrices larger than L2. SC '23 paper numbers remain snippet-only.
